countrySelection.title: Select Countries & Administrative Levels
countrySelection.description: Select countries and their administrative levels to download. Use the matrix to make precise selections.

dataSource.title: Data Source
dataSource.description: Choose a geographic data provider. Each source has different coverage, accuracy, and licensing requirements.
dataSource.licenseRequired: License agreement is required to proceed.
dataSource.clearCache: Clear cache for selected data source
dataSource.cacheCleared: Cleared cache for selected data source.
dataSource.cacheClearFailed: Failed to clear data source cache.

fetch.title: Fetch
fetch.filteringHelp: Applies to filtering at the end of the fetch stage before transform begins.

transform.title: Transform
transform.summaryHelpTurf: Transform runs turf.simplify with the configured tolerance.
transform.summaryHelpGeos: Transform runs geos with the configured tolerance.
transform.geometryEngineHelp: Selects the geometry engine used during transform.

download.title: Fetch stage settings
download.workersHelp: Controls how many fetches run in parallel.
download.deleteTiles: Delete tile index + tile data cache
download.deleteApiCacheHelp: API cache: downloaded raw data for this node (before filtering).
download.deleteFilteredCacheHelp: Filtered cache: fetch-stage filtered feature collections per zoom band.
download.deleteTransformHelp: Simplified cache: simplified geometries by zoom band plus transform error records.
download.deleteVtHelp: Tile index + tile data cache: generated vector tiles and tile relations (also clears feature/source metadata).
download.deleteMetadataHelp: Metadata: feature and source metadata for search/preview (does not remove tiles).
download.timeoutHelp: Maximum time to wait for each fetch before failing.
download.retryAttemptsHelp: Number of retries per failed fetch request.
download.retryDelayHelp: Wait time between retry attempts when a fetch fails.

extract1.title: Transform (Filtering)
extract1.omissionHelp: Small polygons may be excluded based on the polygon area coefficient and feature filtering.

extract2.title: Transform (Tile Preprocessing)
extract2.omissionHelp: When enabled, preprocessing can remove empty geometries.
extract2.extractionModeHelp: Choose how geometry is prepared during tile preprocessing.

filter.title: Transform Settings
filter.workersStage1Help: Higher concurrency can speed up processing but may exhaust browser memory.
filter.workersStage2Help: Higher concurrency can speed up processing but may exhaust browser memory.
filter.areaFilterHelp: Applied during transform filtering (feature filtering and aspect/area checks).
filter.methodHelp: Selects how small features are filtered before transform.
filter.minimumAreaHelp: Filters out features smaller than this area during transform filtering.
filter.aspectRatioThresholdHelp: Filters elongated features during transform when their aspect ratio exceeds this value.
filter.areaThresholdHelp: Minimum area used with the transform aspect ratio filter.
filter.excludePolygonAreaCoefficientHelp: Excludes polygons smaller than coefficient × grid size × outline length / 2 in fetch filtering.
filter.omitDetailsHelp: Filters out small shapes at each zoom using bbox and area thresholds.
filter.omitDetailsClarityNote: Low keeps more detail; High filters more aggressively.
filter.omitDetailsPreviewHelp: Pick a level to see how smaller islands drop out as filtering strengthens.
filter.omitDetailsLevelWeakHelp: Keeps large, medium, and small islands.
filter.toleranceHelp: Higher values straighten boundaries and remove fine details. Small or thin features are more likely to be filtered out in combination with the filters. Downstream (transform preprocessing and VT generation) becomes lighter and smaller, but geometric fidelity decreases.
filter.toleranceHelpStage2: Applies transform preprocessing for tile generation.
filter.minVertexCountHelp: Only apply transform area filtering when feature vertices exceed this count.
filter.quickRejectHelp: Lower values reject more tiny features quickly.
filter.simpleShapeVertexHelp: Vertex count threshold for simple-shape handling.
filter.elongatedShapeHelp: Correction factor for elongated simple shapes.
filter.regularShapeMinRatioHelp: Minimum ratio considered a regular-shaped feature.
filter.regularShapeMaxRatioHelp: Maximum ratio considered a regular-shaped feature.
filter.enablePerFeatureExtraction: Allow transform to omit countries or municipalities
filter.enablePerFeatureExtractionHelp: Geometries may be omitted, but metadata is retained.
filter.boundaryDisableAtZoomOrAbove: Disable boundary handling at zoom or above
filter.boundaryDisableAtZoomOrAboveHelp: Stops boundary preservation above this zoom.
filter.zoomBandRangesHelp: Configure zoom band boundaries and range counts.
filter.zoomBandRangeCountHelp: Controls how many zoom ranges are grouped into bands.
filter.zoomBandBoundariesHelp: Adjust the zoom boundaries between ranges.

tile.title: VT Generation
tile.descriptionTooltip: Generate VT tiles for the selected zoom range.
tile.workersHelp: Concurrent workers for VT generation. Dynamic VT concurrency requires 2+.
tile.extentHelp: Controls the resolution of tile coordinates.
tile.tileSizeHelp: Base tile size used for extent calculations.
tile.toleranceHelp: Simplification tolerance applied during tile generation.
tile.layerSetNameHelp: Name of the output layer group.
tile.promoteIdHelp: Property name used to promote feature IDs.
tile.indexMaxPointsHelp: 0 disables the limit. When exceeded, extra points are skipped from the tile index.
tile.inputFormatHelp: Input data format for tile generation.
tile.outputCompressionHelp: Compression applied to vector tile output.
tile.boundaryDedupeHelp: Remove duplicate boundary lines to reduce tile size.
tile.bufferSizeHelp: 0 disables the margin. Larger values reduce seams but increase overlap.
tile.zoomBandsSummary: Zoom bands follow the Transform range boundaries. The representative zoom is the smallest in each band.
tile.expandFactorHelp: Expand tile groups when assembling TopoJSON buffers.
tile.expandMarginHelp: Extra margin (in tiles) for neighbor selection.
tile.dynamicConcurrencyHelp: Adjusts VT worker counts based on runtime load.
tile.tileCountThresholdHelp: Stops tile generation once the tile count exceeds this value.
tile.zoomLevelsHelp: Zoom levels to generate tiles for.

preview.title: Preview
preview.description: Visualize generated vector tiles on the map.
preview.noTiles: No vector tiles are available yet. Run the build to generate tiles.
preview.waiting: Vector tiles are being prepared. The map will appear once tiles are ready.
